sub_strands.name: Conditional Probability and Inequalities
performance_indicators: Calculate conditional probabilities using Bayes' theorem and multi-stage tree structures.
Formulate and graph sets of linear inequalities to define a visible feasible region.
Determine optimal objective values under real business resource constraints.

sub_strands.name: Nationalist Movements and Governance Challenges
performance_indicators: Analyze internal and external factors that accelerated the struggle for independence across West and East Africa.
Assess the root causes of post-independence civil conflicts and military coups in select African nations.
Evaluate the role of the African Union (AU) in managing continental border adjustments and trade treaties.

sub_strands.name: The Cold War and Non-Aligned Movement
performance_indicators: Examine the socio-political impact of the Cold War on newly sovereign African states.
Assess the principles and relevance of the Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) in modern geopolitics.

sub_strands.name: Weathering, Mass Wasting, and Glaciation
performance_indicators: Differentiate between chemical and physical weathering mechanisms across distinct bioclimatic zones.
Examine the development of glacial erosional and depositional features in alpine and continental highlands.
Map localized mass wasting zones and propose sustainable geomorphic management loops.

sub_strands.name: Global Forestry and Multi-Sector Mining
performance_indicators: Contrast commercial lumbering practices between tropical rainforests and temperate softwood plantations.
Evaluate the socio-environmental impacts of open-cast and deep-shaft mining configurations globally.

sub_strands.name: Elements of Crime and Tort Law
performance_indicators: Deconstruct the legal requirements of criminal liability explicitly focusing on *actus reus* and *mens rea*.
Analyze the components of negligence, defamation, and vicarious liability within tort frameworks.
Map the standard jurisdictional hierarchy and appeal pathways of Kenyan courts.

sub_strands.name: Macroeconomics and Monetary Policies
performance_indicators: Evaluate how central bank monetary instruments control national inflation and liquidity limits.
Construct comprehensive balance of payments profiles highlighting current and capital accounts parameters.

sub_strands.name: Expository Drafts and Semantic Analysis
performance_indicators: Draft analytical policy reviews and legislative critiques using standardized citations.
Deconstruct logical contradictions and targeted euphemisms inside public administration statements.

sub_strands.name: Isimujamii na Makala ya Kitaaluma
performance_indicators: Kufafanua misingi ya isimujamii ikijumuisha sajili mbalimbali (sajili ya hospitali, siasa, biashara).
